# persona bearer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:personaBearer`](gmeow-personaBearer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/personaBearer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent whose expression policy this persona is. Functional and mandatory (SHACL): one persona, one bearer; an agent bears many co-equal personas.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Persona`](../classes/gmeow-Persona.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:personaBearer`](gmeow-personaBearer.md) from [`gmeow:Persona`](../classes/gmeow-Persona.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Persona`](../classes/gmeow-Persona.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`Persona`](../classes/gmeow-Persona.md) to name the single agent whose expression policy it is.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one bearer per persona (it is functional and mandatory) and avoid implying a bearer's personas are ranked — an agent bears many co-equal personas.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:personaBearer`](gmeow-personaBearer.md) once from the persona to its [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); the same agent may bear PRIMARY, PRIVATE, and other co-equal personas.

- ex:drChen [`gmeow:personaBearer`](gmeow-personaBearer.md) ex:chen.
